# Healthcare Reform

This folder documents structural and political changes to the Danish healthcare system, focusing specifically on the upcoming "Sundhedsreformen" (health reform). The material details how this reform is expected to alter patient transitions between hospitals and primary care, and the resulting need to adjust clinical quality indicators—such as 90-day post-surgical mortality tracking—to ensure robust cross-sector collaboration and outcome monitoring.

## Pages

- [[sundhedsreformen]] — Outlines the upcoming Danish health reform and its anticipated effects on primary care transitions and acute surgical quality indicators.
